assets.name: canopy-day-1600-webp
assets.alt: Canopy's machine, etched on parchment: a Victorian telegraph exchange case with a brass porthole, patch cords and three glass bell-jar relays.
assets.notes: Canopy (EXP-001) day plate, Grand Test Bench canon. flux2-klein-4b, canopy.toml entry canopy-day-s2202 (seed 2202, built by build.py from the canon TEMPLATE), finished by canon/finish.py --lens 830,494,232 (no mirror: shadow lower right, 1552 vs 112 dark px; scale 0.862; plinth front edge 0.90). Teal only as hair-thin filaments. Viewer: circle inscribed in the viewer box, inside the clean glass; Canopy's 'brain' canvas goes there with border-radius: 50%. Ground = --bench-c-parchment. The 800 px file is the same framing scaled (no separate mobile crop; the viewer fractions hold at every size).

assets.name: canopy-footer-1600-webp
assets.alt: Top of Canopy's telegraph exchange in chalk lines on dark ink, thin teal filaments in three bell jars.
assets.notes: Canopy footer negative (brief section 6). canon/footer.py --top 0.12 on canopy-night.png: band y 120-520 of the 1600x1000 night plate, ground = --bench-c-ink #1d1510 exactly, chalk lines, teal filaments and copper kept. Use on a footer with background var(--bench-c-ink) and mask-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #000 10%, transparent 78%); top-aligned, full width. The viewer window is cut by the band's bottom edge, so it gets no live canvas here.
